paths.name: node:diagnostics_channel
paths.message: Bun garbage-collects a channel that no code references, together with its subscribers. Use `subscribeDiagnosticsChannel` or `diagnosticsTracingChannel` from `@sentry/server-utils` instead. See https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/issues/43086
